title: Canary plan for typed-contract enforcer with staged rollout, telemetry gating, and SDK compatibility checks
creator: Maya Sullivan
description:
Background: We need a safe, observable path to enforce typed/JSON contracts in streaming responses (JSON mode) without breaking SDK users or tool-calling workflows. This ticket defines a canary + telemetry gating plan for the "typed_contract_enforcer_v2" component that performs constrained decoding and schema validation at the serving layer. The goal is to enable strict mode for eligible traffic incrementally and gather robust signals to drive a full enforcement decision.

Scope:
- Implementation of canary routing + feature flag to direct a percentage of production traffic to the new enforcer.
- Telemetry definition (metrics, alert thresholds, dashboards) focused on schema-failure rate, downstream toolcall mismatches, p95 latency regression, and user-visible errors.
- SDK compatibility smoke tests and a messaging/compatibility layer to transform legacy payloads when strictly required.
- Runbook with automated rollback triggers for rapid mitigation.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: model-level decoding changes (handled in a follow-up), long-lived audit log retention increase (separate infra ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Feature flag typed_contract_enforcer_v2 is gateable and controllable via Console feature flags
Canary routing is able to send 0%, 1%, 5%, 25%, 100% traffic cohorts within a day without requiring code deploy
Dashboards show schema_failure_rate, schema_repair_attempts, toolcall_mismatch_count, p95_latency_delta, and customer_error_rate for canary vs baseline
Automated rollback triggers defined and exercised in a dry-run (thresholds and playbook verified)
SDK compatibility layer contains mappings/transformations for top 5 legacy payload shapes and tests validate no-segfault/parse errors
Runbook documents who to page, how to rollback flag, and how to triage mismatch hunting within 15 minutes
steps: Create feature flag typed_contract_enforcer_v2 and expose in Console (PM + Ops)
Implement canary routing hook in router service with percentage-based cohorts and shadow mode
Add schema_validation telemetry events at enforcement point: (schema_ok|schema_fixable|schema_fail) with sample payload hash
Build dashboard (Dashboards ID TBD) and alert rules: schema_fail_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR p95_latency_delta > 20% triggers critical alert
Ship SDK compatibility transformations (JS + Python) behind a compatibility toggle and attach smoke tests
Execute staged rollout: shadow -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h observation windows and signoff gates
Run a planned rollback drill across 1% and 5% cohorts to validate automation and runbook clarity
test_plan: Unit tests for constrained decoder edge cases (malformed arrays, truncated streams)
Integration test: streaming session with interleaved tool calls asserting no toolbinding regressions
Canary e2e job that replays historical traffic (subset) against enforcer to measure synthetic schema_fail_rate
SDK smoke tests: send legacy payloads and assert graceful fallback or deterministic transformation
Chaos test: inject kv-cache eviction and observe schema_repair_attempts and resulting error surface

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Unexpected SDK clients depend on lenient parsing -> Mitigation: compatibility toggle + transformations and early outreach to top customers
Risk: Schema enforcement causes cascading toolcall mismatches -> Mitigation: shadow mode + automated backoff and detailed mismatch telemetry
Risk: Latency regressions at high percentiles -> Mitigation: p95 alert thresholds and staged observation windows before increasing cohort
Risk: Telemetry blind spots -> Mitigation: include sample payloads and trace ids in events; correlate with Console traces
